title: Sears appoints board member with restructuring experience
主要内容: Sears Holdings added restructuring expert Alan Carr to its board as it faces a key debt payment it may not meet. Carr, CEO of restructuring advisory firm Drivetrain, previously served as director of reorganized businesses. Sears CEO Eddie Lampert welcomed Carr, stating his expertise would help maximize value for the company and stakeholders. Sears shares fell 1.5% premarket, trading at 63 cents, below $1 for the first time. A special committee is evaluating Lampert's proposal to buy assets through his hedge fund ESL Investments, which could reduce Sears' debt by nearly 80% to $1.24 billion. Debtholders must be convinced Sears is worth more than its assets, despite constant losses. The longer Sears delays bankruptcy, the more its asset value may decline. Lampert owns about 31% of Sears' shares, giving him control over the company's fate.
